experiment: H0 vs H1 structured mutation boundary (forced)
question: does requiring explicit declarative edit intent preserve capability, and where does it break?
why_this_one: largest-elimination-first: B/C (current proposal) live or die on this; A vs D ordering also depends on it; zero-model representability is already substantially answered by this audit (78% pattern-cover, 22% richer), so the remaining unknown is purely behavioral and only a live forced test answers it; adoption evidence (0 fill uses, 5/13 query uses) makes optional-path testing uninformative

design.H1: structured mutation required for value/formula writes; free Python retained ONLY for inspection + out-of-IR mutations (styles/xml/charts) with capture
design.population: mechanism-enriched slice reused from deterministic-execution census (08_03 positive witness, 08_04 wrong-canonical control, 08_05 absent-program control, 15_04 boundary + held-out fill-heavy tasks); witnesses pre-registered, no tuning on them
gates: capability first: official exact/usable per matched pair; efficiency conditional on capability preservation
Phase 0 zero-model: lower the 115 archived mutating scripts into the candidate IR; report coverage + awkward-expansion inventory (extends this audit's census)
interception shadow: run H1 episodes with capture-only wrapper first; byte-identity gate before any behavioral claim (de-risks D simultaneously)
forbidden: Task IR, Edit Plan authority, scheduler, retrieval agents, synthesis agents, prompt optimization beyond the IR contract

predictions.if_H1_capability_holds: thin waist earned; proceed to translation-lowering + receipt hardening (B/C viable, D optional)
predictions.if_H1_capability_drops: B/C falsified as required path; pivot to D (interception, Python surface preserved) or A (hardened I/O only); IR survives at most as opt-in lowering
predictions.if_agents_route_around_IR: confirms adoption finding; D dominates (capture what they insist on writing)

cost_note: small witness slice only; stop rules pre-registered as in deterministic-execution spec; provider cost is bounded by the same 60-call/$5 envelope per pair
